title: Human handoff opens the wrong conversation
scenario: After a release that added an Alt+H shortcut, Kestrel contact-center agents receive handoff tickets for an older conversation than the one the customer is on. The handoff API team sees duplicate-request warnings and another engineer blames a new query cache setting.
task: Show which conversation id the page sends and where that value comes from, with quoted evidence
Explain why only customers with several conversations are affected
Rule out the API idempotency warnings and the staleTime change
Fix the handler and the shortcut registration
acceptance: Button and Alt+H send the conversation and transcript on screen after any switches
Late messages and a new client prop are used
One shortcut registration at a time; one press is one handoff
ANSWER.md names the mechanism with evidence
